summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Project Management System - Modules, Projects, Tasks, Subtasks, Checklists, Comments, Activity Logs, and My Tasks Dashboard. All backend APIs working correctly (33 tests passed). Frontend My Tasks dashboard loads and displays properly. Fixed 1 bug: /api/projects/activity route was being matched by /{project_id} - moved activity endpoint above dynamic route.

minor.issue: FIXED - Route was being matched by /{project_id} causing 404. Moved activity endpoint above dynamic route.

issues: Status dropdown within task card opens but selector for inner menu items may need adjustment (non-blocking - UI works via clicks)

projects_api.notes: All CRUD operations work with proper enrichment (module_name, team_member_names, task_count, progress)

tasks_api.notes: Tasks enriched with project_name, module_name, subtask/checklist/comment counts

subtasks_api.notes: Subtasks linked to parent tasks correctly

checklists_api.notes: Checklist completion tracking with completed_by and completed_at fields

my_tasks_dashboard_api.notes: Returns properly categorized tasks with stats (total_assigned, due_today, overdue, in_progress, pending_review, completed_this_week, total_completed)

activity_log_api.notes: FIXED - Now correctly returns activity logs with entity_type, entity_id, action filters

time_logs_api.notes: Time tracking with hours accumulation on tasks

features_verified: Stats cards display (Total Assigned, Due Today, Overdue, Completed)
Tab navigation works (All Tasks, In Progress, Pending Review, Recently Done)
Task cards display with priority badge, module badge, project name

critical_code_review_comments: Backend routes/projects.py: Fixed route ordering - /activity must be defined before /{project_id} to avoid incorrect matching
MyTasks.jsx: Well-structured component with proper state management and API integration
Task enrichment in backend properly fetches related project/module names and counts
updated_files: /app/backend/routes/projects.py - Moved /activity route above /{project_id} route to fix 404 bug
/app/backend/tests/test_project_management.py - New comprehensive test file for PM system
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during pytest run. Existing seed data: 1 module (Marketing Projects), 1 project (Q1 Campaign Launch), 1 task (Create campaign brief) assigned to superadmin
context_for_next_testing_agent: Project Management System fully tested. All CRUD operations for Modules, Projects, Tasks, Subtasks, Checklists, Comments work. My Tasks dashboard at /projects/my-tasks shows tasks assigned to current user with stats and filtering. Route ordering bug in /activity endpoint has been fixed. Sidebar navigation includes My Tasks link (data-testid='sidebar-my-tasks').
